title: TRUE takes no arguments, refuses any argument at entry, and returns the logical TRUE
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, TRUE() takes zero arguments, rejects any argument or call postfix at formula entry, and evaluates to the logical value TRUE (distinct from the text string "TRUE": logical TRUE compares greater than numbers and text, and coerces to 1 only as a direct argument while being skipped in cell ranges by numeric aggregates).
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0 build 20430 (1/1 pinned row, 2/2 full-bank rows), Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in dc_xrxb (row 68) and dc_fwpz (row 1), and excel-entry.tsv.
